## type [KeybindingInfo](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/commands/inspector/model.go#L27-L32>)

KeybindingInfo contains properties of a registered keybinding.

<a name="PluginInfo"></a>
## type [PluginInfo](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/pkg/foundation/commands/inspector/model.go#L16-L24>)

PluginInfo contains high\-level metadata about a registered plugin.

```go [model.go]
type PluginInfo struct {
    ID          string        `json:"id"`
    Name        string        `json:"name"`
    Type        string        `json:"type"`
    Version     string        `json:"version"`
    Description string        `json:"description"`
    Failed      bool          `json:"failed"`
    LoadTime    time.Duration `json:"load_time"`
}
```
